title: One Light Day
one_liner: Ride along with Voyager 1: a live signal delay, a draining power budget and instruments switching off by year.
headline: Send a simulated command to Voyager 1, watch its power budget fade over 50 years, and see how far past its five-year design life it's flown.

episode.title: Steve Jurvetson on the SpaceX Deal That Almost Didn’t Happen | EP #314

history.summary: A tight, well-scoped single-screen demo that nails the brief: a working signal round-trip animation, a power-decay slider that greys out instruments at labeled (and honestly flagged as made-up) thresholds, and a comparison panel for design life and speed. Every real number is sourced to a verified podcast figure and tagged, assumptions are clearly separated from facts, and the mobile/desktop layouts are clean with no overflow or console errors. No must-fix issues; only polish-level suggestions remain.
